items.title: Emile Barnes Interview, 1962-01-03
items.q: Oh yeah. I worked with Bunk after that.

ctx.x: How about Bunk? Really, did you ever play with Bunk? Did you ever see him after the time he got you to clarinet?

Oh yeah. I worked with Bunk after that. He used to talk about us. Tell me all the time. He brought up with me. He used to say, well, you wouldn't have saw that you'd be playing. I bought a clarinet for a year and you'd be playing with me today. That's true. I was playing with Bunk. I was playing with Bunk.
Who was in Bunk's band then? Was Bunk the leader of the band then? Yeah. You played with him?

items.title: Emile Barnes Interview, 1960-12-20
items.q: Yeah, Bump Johnson. He used to keep Lloyd for that.

ctx.x: Yeah, Bump Johnson. He used to keep Lloyd for that. You see Corrine, Corrine, oh, since you've been gone. You see, that was old time. Then you go along and work and Italy. That was another one too. Italy? Italy.
Yeah, I don't remember that. I heard about that.
